prose.rule: PRESENT+ share >= 0.65, none PRESENT-, none ABSENT

children.rule: every defined sibling z > 0 in both halves, none PRESENT-, PRESENT+ share <= 0.50

notation.rule: no sibling PRESENT of either sign, at least one ABSENT

multiplicity.note: under no effect P(|z|<2 in both halves) is about 0.83-0.85, so a lone ABSENT is weak evidence
